description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for MediaTek MT7623 based devices, including full system upgrade, image checking, and configuration copying.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full system upgrade for MediaTek SoCs on eMMC or SD cards, handling partition copying, UUID writing, and recovery mode updates.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Determines device type and performs the appropriate upgrade method, handling full upgrades or partial images.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the provided image is valid for the current device based on magic numbers and board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backups to the recovery partition for specific device types.
